final: WITH counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY account_count DESC) AS share_rank FROM counts) SELECT district_id, account_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= (SELECT share_rank FROM ranked ORDER BY account_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) ORDER BY share DESC, district_id
